text:
Aria M.: quick idea dump: we should introduce an explicit 'affinity_provenance' field in rollout metadata (values: user, controller, autoscaler) + an opaque affinity_token so operators can reclaim stale implicit pins.
Tobias R.: +1. need to decide lifecycle: if affinity_token exists but no owner ack for X mins, autoscaler can evict unless affinity_strength==hard. also how to surface to SDKs?
Leena P.: SDKs should expose affinity_provenance but never treat it as a guarantee. affinity_strength: low|medium|high. high == try eviction protection but still fall back. hard locks are dangerous.
Aria M.: propose manifest snippet (human only):
```
{ model_id: "rwd-llama-3", variant: "m", rollout: { affinity_provenance: "controller", affinity_token: "aff_0xabc", affinity_strength: "medium", expires_ms: 1718000000000 } }
```
Tobias R.: server rules: canonicalize expires_ms (epoch ms), annotate records with provenance history (list of events) and set stale_flag if last_renew > expires_ms. do not reject updates on mismatch; instead set mismatch=true and enqueue rebind job.
Leena P.: telemetry: emit affinity_ignored events when routers bypass affinity for SLO reasons. create dashboard: affinity success rate by provenance.
ops-bot: NOTICE: scheduled job affinity-reaper runs hourly.
Aria M.: next steps: Tobias add schema + validation; Leena add SDK note and telemetry; ops review reaper thresholds. aim RFC follow-up in 2 weeks.
ci-bot: DEPLOY: rollout/affinity-schema-proto test started by Tobias R.
Tobias R.: will submit PR with schema and tests by Thursday.
Leena P.: will add SDK item to backlog and draft telemetry panels.
